text:
Ava (platform): quick sync — we need a concise, exportable span naming + attr set for LLM requests. goal: usable across hosted/dedicated/private, easy to filter for billing dashboards, and safe for privacy. thoughts?

Dev (eng-runtime): +1. current chaos: some teams use `inference.call`, others `llm.request`, and a few have model-specific names like `gpt4.generate`. makes querying messy.

Ravi (eng-ml): my vote: one canonical span name for the high-level call, then attrs for model + phase. e.g. `redwood.infer.request` and attr `infer.phase = "frontend|backend|decode"` so we can group. avoids proliferation. :thumbsup:

Jo (security): important: do NOT put prompt text in spans. we can include a prompt_hash and prompt_token_count but no raw text or long prompt slices. compliance will flag otherwise. :warning:

Dev (eng-runtime): example proposal for span.name + attrs (rough):
```
span.name = "redwood.infer.request"
attributes:
  service.name = "redwood-inference"
  infer.model.name = "gpt-j-6b"        # stable model id
  infer.model.revision = "r2"          # pinned variant
  infer.model.quant = "int8"           # perf hint
  infer.variant = "fast"               # policy variant
  infer.phase = "decode"               # optional: prepare|batch|decode
  infer.routing_policy = "latency-priority|cost-priority"
  infer.kv_cache.hits = 3                # integer
  infer.kv_cache.prefix_hit = true       # boolean
  infer.tokens.prompt = 120              # tokens in
  infer.tokens.generated = 45            # tokens out
  infer.tokens.total = 165               # convenience
  infer.prompt_hash = "sha256:abc123"  # 1-way, no PII
  telemetry.sampling_rate = "1e-2"      # sampler hint
```

Ravi (eng-ml): +1 for numeric token attrs. prefer `infer.tokens.in`/`infer.tokens.out` over `prompt/generated`? consistency matters. maybe `tokens.{in,out,total}` is clearer.

Ava (platform): I like `infer.*` prefix. smaller namespace collision risk. also: for billing pipelines BigQuery expects flat scalar attributes — good.

Jo (security): two notes: 1) prompt_hash MUST be salted per-customer to avoid rainbow table risks; 2) drop any user identifiers from span attributes unless customer explicit consent. we should have a scrubber in the OTEL collector.

Dev (eng-runtime): about kv cache, question: boolean vs count? ops wants `kv_cache.hits` (int) and `kv_cache.misses` for aggregate metrics. for fast filtering `kv_cache.prefix_hit` boolean is helpful.

Ravi (eng-ml): Also propose `infer.quality.eval_id` for linking to eval sets when we run regression checks. string id only.

Ava (platform): exporters/retention: short-term full spans (7d) at full fidelity, then roll up to aggregated metrics + sampled spans (no prompt_hash or token counts?) for long-term analytics (90d+). thoughts?

Jo (security): token counts can be considered sensitive in some regions. we should make retention policy configurable per-tenant. default: keep token counts only in short-term; store aggregated token histograms for long-term.

Dev (eng-runtime): practical OTLP/collector config stub for collectors to implement filtering/sampling before export: 
```
receivers:
  otlp:
processors:
  batch:
  probabilistic_sampler:
    sampling_percentage: 1.0
  attributes:
    actions:
      - key: "body"           # strip any accidental user text
        action: delete
      - key: "prompt"
        action: delete
exporters:
  otlp/analytics:
    endpoint: "otlp-analytics.internal:4317"
  jaeger/local:
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch,probabilistic_sampler,attributes]
      exporters: [otlp/analytics, jaeger/local]
```

Dev (eng-runtime): also recommend adding a decorator in the runtime to compute `tokens.*` and `kv_cache.*` before span end so exporters get consistent fields.

Ravi (eng-ml): query ergonomics: dashboards should expose computed fields like cost_estimate = tokens.total * cost_per_token(model). keep cost_per_token out of spans (config).

Ava (platform): sampling rules for high-volume customers: send 100% first 10s of a new model rollout, then downsample to 1% for steady-state. we should add `telemetry.rollout_phase = "canary|ramp|steady"`.

Jo (security): + enforce tenant opt-out where customers can disable prompt_hashing or token export for privacy-sensitive tenants. document defaults clearly in privacy policy.

infra-bot: OTEL collector redeploy succeeded for region-us-west-2 (tag: telemetry-v3).

Dev (eng-runtime): next steps: I'll draft a short RFC with: canonical span name, canonical attribute list (finalized), collector config snippets, retention defaults, and a migration guide. target review by EOD Friday.

Ava (platform): perfect. @Ravi @Jo please add any must-have attr names here before EOD so I can include them in the RFC.

Ravi (eng-ml): add `infer.model.size_class = "small|medium|large"` for coarse bucketing.

Jo (security): add `telemetry.sensitivity = "low|medium|high"` tag per-tenant to gate exporters.

Ava (platform): cool — I'll roll these in. thanks all! :heart:
